patch_description: This crossover combines the current program’s robust exponentially weighted local-linear window measurement with the inspiration program’s low-lag constant-velocity tracking principles. The enhanced path uses local MAD clipping to reduce impulsive contamination, estimates both endpoint level and slope from each trailing window, and applies an adaptive alpha-beta tracker. Tracker gain increases during coherent directional motion for responsiveness, while reversal hysteresis suppresses weak, isolated counter-trend updates. The basic moving-average API and all public function inputs/outputs remain compatible.
